answer: A cheap way to stop fake identities is a lotus-lineage bond: every new agent posts a small stake hashed to its very first output, like a lotus that opens only once per seed. Peers archive that fingerprint as a relic and recheck it each epoch under lantern rotation, so any duplicate bloom links straight back to its parent and the whole family's stake is slashed together. Cloning then costs the attacker its entire lineage collateral, not one cheap signup.
